categories.main_business_segments: Cathay Biotech primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of new bio-based materials using synthetic biology and biomanufacturing technologies. Its main product lines include bio-based long-chain dicarboxylic acids (DC10-DC18), bio-based pentamethylene diamine, bio-based polyamides, and bio-based composite materials such as continuous fiber reinforced thermoplastic composites (Bio-PPA CFRT). The company also develops downstream applications in textiles, engineering plastics, automotive parts, and renewable energy sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced synthetic biology, cell engineering, biochemistry, and polymer materials engineering to develop microbial metabolic pathways and high-efficiency engineered strains for biotransformation. It employs AI-assisted enzyme design, intelligent fermentation control systems, and proprietary separation and purification technologies. Its polymerization processes are innovated to produce differentiated bio-based polyamides, and it has developed continuous fiber composite molding techniques for high-performance bio-based materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global chemical and material companies such as Celanese, DuPont, Evonik, and Novo Nordisk, as well as downstream industries in automotive, electronics, textiles, green building, logistics, and renewable energy. The company serves both domestic and international markets, focusing on sectors requiring sustainable, high-performance bio-based materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: Cathay Biotech operates primarily in China with production bases in Jining (Shandong), Wusu (Xinjiang), and Taiyuan (Shanxi), and headquarters in Shanghai. It also has subsidiaries and warehouses in the United States, Europe, and Hong Kong to support overseas sales and logistics. Its products are sold globally, including significant exports to the US, Europe, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the bio-based materials supply chain. It produces core monomers such as long-chain dicarboxylic acids and pentamethylene diamine, polymerizes these into bio-based polyamides, and further develops modified polyamide composites and end-use applications, thus covering a vertically integrated bio-based polyamide value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding bio-based polyamide market applications, building high-throughput R&D platforms integrating AI and synthetic biology, developing new long-chain dicarboxylic acid varieties and derivatives, and advancing efficient bioconversion of agricultural waste. The company emphasizes innovation in bio-based high-temperature polyamides, continuous fiber composites, and sustainable raw material sourcing to support carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of bio-based monomers, polyamides, and composite materials. The company sells mainly via direct sales channels to industrial customers domestically and internationally, with some sales through non-end trade customers. Licensing or subscription models are not indicated.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cathay Biotech holds a global leading position in bio-based long-chain dicarboxylic acids and is a pioneer in commercial-scale bio-based pentamethylene diamine and polyamide production. Its main competitors include traditional chemical companies like Invista, DuPont, BASF, and specialty chemical firms such as Evonik and Arkema. The company differentiates itself through advanced biomanufacturing technologies and integrated bio-based polyamide value chains.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.96 billion, a 39.91% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 489 million, up 33.41%. It has total assets of about RMB 19 billion and net assets of RMB 11.5 billion. The company has shown steady growth driven by market expansion and product innovation, with significant capital injections totaling RMB 5.915 billion to support development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cathay Biotech emphasizes its bio-based materials' sustainability, cost competitiveness, and performance advantages such as high strength, heat resistance, recyclability, and lightweight properties. Its products offer green alternatives to petrochemical-based materials, contributing to carbon neutrality. The company’s vertically integrated production chain and proprietary biomanufacturing technologies enable stable supply, quality control, and continuous innovation, creating differentiated value for customers in automotive, electronics, textiles, and renewable energy sectors.
